proof_body:
by
  intro n a hn hs hd hc
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn) with h1 | h1
  · rw [← h1]
    exact Nat.modEq_one
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [Nat.coprime_zero_left] at hc
    omega
  have hpos : 1 ≤ a ^ (n - 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha)
  have key : n ∣ a ^ (n - 1) - 1 := by
    have hprod := Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hs
    have hd2 : ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ∣ a ^ (n - 1) - 1 := by
      apply Finset.prod_primes_dvd
      · intro p hp
        exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).prime
      · intro p hp
        have pp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        have pn := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        haveI := Fact.mk pp
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hd p pp pn
        have hna : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
          intro e
          have h2 : p ∣ a := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a p).1 e
          have := Nat.dvd_gcd h2 pn
          rw [hc] at this
          exact pp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.1 this)
        have e1 : (a : ZMod p) ^ (n - 1) = 1 := by
          rw [hk, pow_mul, ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hna, one_pow]
        apply (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).1
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos]
        push_cast
        rw [e1, sub_self]
    rwa [hprod] at hd2
  exact ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hpos).2 key).symm
target_source: ∀ n a : ℕ, 0 < n → Squarefree n → (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n → (p - 1) ∣ (n - 1)) → Nat.Coprime a n → a ^ (n - 1) ≡ 1 [MOD n]
